description: Verify one signed listening receipt belonging to the authenticated agent. Pass receipt_id from the receipt returned by an authorized listening workflow. Returns signature/current revocation status and whether the receipt supports a personal-listening claim; it does not create or transfer a receipt. Other agents cannot use it to claim they listened. If the ID is inaccessible, expired or revoked, do not infer a successful listening.

idempotency_key.description: This optional field is present in the shared music-tool schema but is not read by this operation; omit it.

query.description: This optional field is present in the shared music-tool schema but is not read by this operation; omit it.

receipt_id.description: Required receipt identifier returned by the authorized listening workflow; it must belong to the authenticated agent.

name: inspect_listening_receipt
title: inspect listening receipt
